_comment: Curated files that matter for Stoppr (VibeKB 0.2.0). Each entry has path, purpose, functionality[], runs_when, depended_on_by[], depends_on[], safety, test_after_change, provenance. Regenerated 2026-07-23 against commit 2edc099.

files.purpose: Cold-start bootstrap: dotenv, RevenueCat, Firebase, analytics, notifications, Superwall, deep links, and startup routing into onboarding, paywall, or MainScaffold.
files.runs_when: Every cold start and when AppLinks or notification payloads arrive.
files.test_after_change: Cold start for anonymous, free, and paid users; deep links; notification open paths.

files.purpose: Env-backed DefaultFirebaseOptions for Android/iOS only; missing keys assert at startup.
files.runs_when: Firebase.initializeApp during bootstrap.
files.test_after_change: Cold start with complete Firebase env names present.

files.purpose: Typed accessors for environment variable NAMES used by Firebase, purchases, AI, and analytics. Never commit values.
files.runs_when: Whenever a service reads configuration.
files.test_after_change: Missing-key behavior; ensure no secrets are logged.

files.purpose: Firebase Auth (Google, Apple, email) plus RevenueCat/Mixpanel identity sync and users/{uid} profile writes. Google OAuth fallbacks are placeholders when env is missing.
files.runs_when: Sign-in, sign-out, and auth state changes.
files.test_after_change: Google/Apple/email sign-in; anonymous upgrade; RevenueCat logIn.

files.purpose: Central Firestore user document hub for profile, streak mirrors, subscription fields, and related user subcollections.
files.runs_when: Profile reads/writes and many feature repositories.
files.test_after_change: Profile edit; streak mirror; auth user document creation.

files.purpose: Paid-access decisions from Superwall subscription status and RevenueCat CustomerInfo. Firestore subscription fields are not the entitlement source of truth.
files.runs_when: Gating checks throughout the app and at startup routing.
files.test_after_change: Free vs paid routing; bypass accounts; restore purchases.

files.purpose: Maps Superwall purchase/restore actions to RevenueCat and syncs subscription status back to Superwall.
files.runs_when: Purchase, restore, and status sync.
files.test_after_change: iOS and Android purchase/restore paths with a real purchase controller attached.

files.purpose: Soft-paywall quota counters and Firestore user_feature_quotas helpers. Call sites often gate behind QUOTA_SYSTEM_ENABLED = false.
files.runs_when: Feature entry points that check free usage limits.
files.test_after_change: Toggle QUOTA_SYSTEM_ENABLED and confirm limits plus Superwall placements.

files.purpose: Primary paywall UI and Superwall placement registration. Many placement IDs remain INSERT_YOUR_* placeholders.
files.runs_when: End of onboarding or unpaid return to paywall.
files.test_after_change: Placement registration; paid skip; purchase success; gift/standard placements.

files.purpose: SharedPreferences + Firestore resume checkpoints and onboarding_completed for startup routing.
files.runs_when: Each onboarding screen save and cold-start resume.
files.test_after_change: Kill-app resume at multiple onboarding screens; completion flag.

files.purpose: Bottom-tab shell hosting Home, Learn, Rewire, Community, and Profile with initialIndex deep-link entry.
files.runs_when: After paid/onboarding routing reaches the main app.
files.test_after_change: Tab switching; initialIndex from deep links.

files.purpose: Daily hub UI: streak, pledge, panic entry, banners, and soft Superwall triggers.
files.runs_when: Home tab visible.
files.test_after_change: Banner paywalls; navigation to panic/pledge; streak display.

files.purpose: Streak persistence (SharedPreferences + Firestore) and home_widget sync. iOS app group id is still group.YOUR_BUNDLE_ID.shared.
files.runs_when: Streak updates, relapse resets, and widget refreshes.
files.test_after_change: Streak increment/reset; iOS/Android widget values with a real app group.

files.purpose: Daily pledge/check-in persistence under users/{uid}/pledges.
files.runs_when: User completes or updates a daily pledge.
files.test_after_change: Create pledge success/failure; streak interaction.

files.purpose: Guided multi-step panic intervention orchestration used from Home and deep links.
files.runs_when: User opens panic flow or stoppr://panic.
files.test_after_change: Complete panic steps; deep link entry.

files.purpose: Relapse recovery helpers that can reset streak state after a failed check-in.
files.runs_when: User indicates relapse / failed pledge.
files.test_after_change: Relapse path resets streak and recovers UI state.

files.purpose: Community posts/comments Firestore repository for the forum surface.
files.runs_when: Community tab loads or user posts/comments.
files.test_after_change: Create post/comment; blocked-user filtering path.

files.purpose: Accountability partnerships and matching pool persistence.
files.runs_when: Partner invite, accept, or pool matching flows.
files.test_after_change: Invite/accept partnership; pool entry; paid gating.

files.purpose: Hardcoded Mux HLS lesson catalog, subtitle assets, and local completion tracking.
files.runs_when: Learn video list/player opens.
files.test_after_change: Play lesson; completion persistence; quota flag path.

files.purpose: Melinda CBT assistant using Groq chat/transcription and OpenAI speech, with daily API interaction limits.
files.runs_when: Chatbot screen opened.
files.test_after_change: Text and voice paths; daily rate limit; soft-paywall flag.

files.purpose: Sugar/food vision scan UI with Groq-compatible analysis and disabled feature-quota soft paywall.
files.runs_when: User opens food scan.
files.test_after_change: Scan a plate photo; quota disabled vs enabled; Superwall placement id.

files.purpose: Nutrition Firestore hub for food_logs, daily_summaries, goals, body metrics, and workouts.
files.runs_when: Food log and nutrition goal operations.
files.test_after_change: Log food; load daily summary; update goals.

files.purpose: Recipe search via Edamam with Spoonacular fallback and OpenAI-assisted detail paths.
files.runs_when: Recipe search or detail fetch.
files.test_after_change: Search recipes; fallback path; favorite save.

files.purpose: Rate My Plate camera/scoring flow with Groq vision and disabled quota soft paywall.
files.runs_when: User opens Rate My Plate.
files.test_after_change: Score a plate; quota flag; Superwall placement id.

files.purpose: In-app meditation UI also reachable via stoppr://meditation.
files.runs_when: Meditation opened from Home or deep link.
files.test_after_change: Open from Home and stoppr://meditation.

files.purpose: Twenty-eight day challenge progression in SharedPreferences and users/{uid}/challenges.
files.runs_when: Challenge day/task updates.
files.test_after_change: Advance a challenge day; task completion persistence.

files.purpose: Local-only fasting logs and active timer cache in SharedPreferences.
files.runs_when: Fasting start/stop or history load.
files.test_after_change: Start/stop fast; history survives restart.

files.purpose: Local notifications and FCM preference storage; some payloads map to placeholder Superwall placements.
files.runs_when: Scheduling, preference changes, and notification open handling.
files.test_after_change: Schedule local notification; open payload routing; preference toggles.

files.purpose: Primary product analytics wrapper around Mixpanel.
files.runs_when: App events and identity sync after auth.
files.test_after_change: Event fires after key actions; identify after login.

files.purpose: Server-side Firestore access rules for users, community, accountability, and related collections.
files.runs_when: Every Firestore request.
files.test_after_change: Rules unit tests / emulator for affected paths.

files.purpose: Package identity (stoppr 7.4.2+1), SDK constraint, and dependency set.
files.runs_when: Build and dependency resolution.
files.test_after_change: flutter pub get; smoke build.
